svg.text: PTT Safety — key-up gates and independent release responsibilities
LAYER 0 · KEY-UP PRECONDITIONS
11 whole-model-unverified entries require MRRC_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_TX=1 · SCU-LAN10 network TX remains forbidden
Unknown TX path means no silent carrier · listen/SDR roles cannot key · releases are never gated
CLIENT NORMAL RELEASE · Layers 1–3
Touch/mouse cancel → ptt:false on /WSradio or terminal JSON
500 ms watchdog + fresh TX state · keyed_by_other stands down
SERVER OWNERSHIP · Layers 4 / 4b
Per-socket keyer + TX owner · same-session deterministic takeover
Foreign release ignored · keyer/owner disconnect forces RX
TERMINAL · AD-039 shared safety
Media backpressure drops frame, never control/PTT socket
One socket = keyer + owner → disconnect force-RX exactly once
UNLOAD / MEDIA CLEANUP · Layers 5–7
beforeunload beacon · pagehide release · stop stream + clear queue
Fire-and-forget backend unkey; no triple 200 ms verify loop
AUTOMATED TX / RESTART · Layers 8–9 · AD-020
CQ finite frame count + abort paths · FT8 uses same release chain
Config/certificate restart releases before os._exit(42)
HALF-OPEN / ZOMBIE · Layer 10
txhb liveness only for capable key-holding session
Independent max-continuous-TX watchdog · both opt-in
PROCESS-DEATH BOUNDARY
Native crash or kill -9 runs no Python release layer · enable the radio's hardware Time-Out Timer
Close streams before PortAudio reinit · backend release failures are bounded · reconnect reconciles authoritative state
VERIFICATION
Normal/foreign release · owner disconnect · terminal exactly-once · heartbeat negatives · restart · backend gates
RX field evidence never implies TX verification · Windows Proactor final SunSDR PTT0 remains an open issue
